items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: you know they booked me at the Steel Pier in Atlantic City opening for Smokey Robinson and the Miracles.

ctx.x: Did you ever suffer the death like that?

Yeah sometimes it happens. You know Al Jolson was nuts when he said no such thing as a bad audience. You get audiences — somebody did a test many, many years ago, maybe 75 years ago or something, in New York City where they had every entity that had entertainment call in to a certain phone bank and rate the audiences after each show.
